div.div: The Pre-Startup sequence involves performing Error Injection diagnostics that lead to device resets as part of normal execution.

div.div: PreMain is placed in .init3, which is part of the set of memory sections that run before the main function.

div.div: While running the Scheduler, IRQs can interrupt execution to run ISRs that will run the appropriate Interrupts Task Manager for each interrupt vector related to system errors.

switch.text: While running the Scheduler, IRQs can...

div.div: Once all diagnostics are completed, the Pre-startup sequence is completed and the Task Manager returns normally.
